origin.source: Flue defineAgent + defineTool (Valibot input/output, run({ input, signal })) calling runAgent; typechecks standalone via local flue-shims mirroring flueframework.com/docs as of 2026-07 (@flue/runtime is not a repo dependency)

comparison.purpose: The Flue LLM agent gets two tools bridging to a statelyai/agent machine: start_workflow runs runAgent to idle/done and returns a JSON-safe handle + interaction label; resume_workflow revives the handle with the human's decision. The machine owns legality; the agent converses.
